---
title: "After the course"
---
Several modules of the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) answer questions that the three days raise without settling. [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd) and [Missing answers](../../companion/missingness.qmd) take apart the two measurement-level decisions that the menu opens beyond the Multi100 task, and [The items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd) examines the instrument behind every outcome on it. [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd) goes one step below the scales and fits a single item of that instrument as a yes-or-no outcome on the real respondents. [The individual level](../../companion/individual-level.qmd) fits the same claim at the level at which its author fitted it, on a synthetic person-level dataset, and answers the question of composition – whether an aggregate association comes from the mix of people in each country-year or from the national conditions they live in – which the aggregate panel can only pose.

The [self-study track](../self-study/index.qmd) takes the EU-frames case as the last of the four cases of the course, after the housing-audit, immigration-and-trust and cohabitation cases, with the companion modules between them.
